Players Committee card image of [[Corporal Vandolay (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 1 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may take an ISB agent here into hand. Once per turn, if you just drew an ISB agent for battle destiny anywhere, may take that card into hand to cancel and re-draw that destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/corporalvandolay.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
